alloys.description: Investigated austenitic low-density steel with nominal composition Fe-30.5Mn-8Al-1C (wt%); prepared by vacuum melting, forged into a billet, and hot-rolled to 4 mm thickness. All ST and aged samples in the study are based on this single composition.

source.reason: 论文明确报告研究材料的名义成分为 Fe-30.5Mn-8Al-1C (wt%)，全文所有 ST 与时效样品均基于此单一成分体系。

paper.paper_scope: Systematic investigation of the tension–tension fatigue behavior and deformation mechanisms of solution-treated and aging-treated Fe-30.5Mn-8Al-1C (wt%) austenitic low-density steel, focusing on the critical role of intragranular and intergranular κ-carbide precipitation state in controlling fatigue properties.
paper.title: Fatigue properties of Fe-30.5Mn-8Al-1C austenitic low-density steel: Critical impact of κ-carbide precipitation state

processes.description: Solution treatment at 1050°C for 1 h, followed by water quenching to room temperature; fully austenitic reference condition without aging-induced κ-carbides.
processes.process_name: Solution treatment at 1050°C for 1 h followed by water quenching
processes.processes_notes: Reference condition; serves as the precursor for all aged conditions.

source.reason: b0015 明确给出固溶处理工艺为 1050°C/1 h 后水淬至室温，并命名为 ST。

processes.description: Aging of solution-treated samples at 550°C for 6 h; produces a high density of nanoscale intragranular κ-carbides (~11 nm) with no coarse grain-boundary precipitation.

source.reason: b0015 规定将 ST 样品在 550°C 时效 6 h，记为 550-6；b0024 进一步给出该态晶内 κ 碳化物尺寸约 11 nm。

processes.description: Aging of solution-treated samples at 600°C for 6 h; intragranular κ-carbides coarsen to ~18 nm, with concurrent observable intergranular κ-carbide precipitation.

source.reason: b0015 规定将 ST 样品在 600°C 时效 6 h，记为 600-6；b0024 给出该态晶内 κ 碳化物约 18 nm 并出现晶间析出。

processes.description: Aging of solution-treated samples at 650°C for 6 h; intragranular κ-carbides coarsen to ~24 nm, accompanied by more pronounced intergranular κ-carbide precipitation.

source.reason: b0015 规定将 ST 样品在 650°C 时效 6 h，记为 650-6；b0024 给出该态晶内 κ 碳化物约 24 nm 且晶间析出更显著。
固溶处理态 Fe-30.5Mn-8Al-1C 钢样品，即 ST 条件，为全文参照研究对象。

unmapped_findings: Fatigue strength (maximum stress amplitude sustained for 10^7 cycles without failure): ST 157.5 MPa, 550-6 162 MPa, 600-6 175.5 MPa, 650-6 171 MPa (b0035).
Intragranular κ-carbide sizes after 6 h aging: ~11 nm (550-6), ~18 nm (600-6), ~24 nm (650-6) (b0024).
